generation_edits.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. NEW production jump whole-body animation atlas of the EXACT man in Image1 (new character design) and Image2 (new full pose model). Image3 is only the OLD pose/role guide; IGNORE its generic young face. Image4 is the photograph.
Ivo: middle-aged man in the photograph, LONG RECTANGULAR face, visible mature brow and under-eye creases, gently receding temples, modest flat natural side-parted short dark-brown hair, straight substantial nose, thin closed lips, squared chin. Serious calm experienced adult, not a young anime fighter.
Preserve the NEW model's larger expressive head, real face proportions, adult age, body build and entire outfit in EVERY cell, including long/rolled sleeves exactly as the new model wears them. Never regress to the old angry anime face or muscular substitute. Face near-frontal three-quarter looking RIGHT where possible, identity recognizable at native SNES 67-73px whole-body height. Connected full drawings, no pasted parts. Same fixed physical scale, limb/head proportions and costume across all poses. Neutral standing height about 300 source pixels, lower crouches/jumps compress naturally. Any raised fist must stay at or BELOW neutral standing crown by bending knees, NEVER enlarge a crouched figure to fill its cell.
Exactly 16 separated figures, FOUR columns by 4 rows, row-major order:
1. neutral anchor; 2. takeoff compression; 3. upward extension; 4. landing compression; 5. air punch windup; 6. air punch contact; 7. air punch recovery; 8. air kick windup; 9. air kick contact; 10. kick recovery extra; 11. apex guard; 12. descent landing release; 13. neutral extra; 14. air guard extra; 15. landing extra; 16. neutral extra 2.
Keep neutral and scale-reference poses upright. Active airborne punch/kick must extend toward RIGHT, other guarded/jump anticipation/landing poses remain compact with consistent head size and body scale.
Use Image3 for exact pose role/placement only and redraw the photographed NEW model from Images1/2. Original 1992 arcade cel cartoon, strong dark navy contours, broad clean flat shading. Generous transparent gutters and SINGLE connected silhouette per cell. No FX/glow/shadow, floor, grid, text, labels, background, extra people or detached limbs. True transparent PNG. Complete hands and feet, no clipping or cropped silhouettes.
